Your drafts stay in this browser until you share them. Submitted reviews become proposals; accepted reviews change the shared report.

Project issue ↗

Review process

  1. Review. Filter scripts and expand a row. Compare the maintainer verdict with source findings and linked discussions.
  2. Correct. Choose your verdict, adjust capability weights/coverage, and add notes or comments. Drafts save only in this browser; notes alone do not change the verdict.
  3. Share. Send to GitHub opens a 3rd party discussion with title, readable changes and export filled in. Attach the downloaded JSON if prompted, then publish. One account can create several discussions.
  4. Incorporate. Give the discussion to the AI. It checks the author, report version and major source features, retains hashes, and explains disagreements. The maintainer decides which corrections to accept.
  5. Follow up. Accepted changes appear in a new report with contributor and discussion links. Reuse unchanged source checks; revisit changed hashes. Export/Import moves drafts between browsers or report sites.

Focus a script row: 1–7 chooses a verdict, 0 uses Weighted, N opens its note. Shortcuts are disabled while typing.
